findings.detail: A07 observed pct_sum is 0.0%, but the source schedule total reports investments at 161.28% of net assets for June 30, 2023.

rationale: The raw source schedule includes the Percentage of Net Assets column and its June 30, 2023 total investments row reports fair value 659,021 and 161.28% of net assets. The reviewed artifact reports pct_sum=0.0%, so the aggregate percentage was not extracted/mapped even though it is present in the filing.
